english.note: Use this when “fence” means an abstract or actual boundary rather than the physical structure itself.
Use this in cricket when referring to one of the marked lines on the pitch.

examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gaai3 sin3 m4 ho2 ji5 jyut6 gwo3

examples.english: The cricket player stepped over the crease, so the umpire stopped play.
examples.traditional: 板球員企過咗界線，俾裁判吹停。
